items.title: Chevron’s CFO on Elevated Oil Prices and Leading Through Volatility
items.summary: It may be a while before companies and consumers get any relief from higher oil prices.  Speaking Tuesday at a WSJ Leadership Institute dinner in New York, Chevron CFO Eimear Bonner said higher energy prices are likely to stick around until shipping flows resume through the Strait of Hormuz at a predictable level and more refining capacity comes back online.  “Until we see changes in both of those levers, prices are likely to stay elevated,” Bonner said at a dinner for financial and sustainability officers that coincided with the United Nations General Assembly.
